title: ELECTRICAL FUNDAMENTALS I
description: Analysis of linear circuits. Circuit laws and theorems. DC responses of circuits. Operational amplifier characteristics and applications.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (MTH 251Z, 251HZ, 251 or 251H) and (MTH 252Z, 252HZ, 252 or 252H).
A minimum grade of C is required in MTH 251Z, MTH 251HZ, MTH 251, MTH 251H, MTH 252Z, MTH 252HZ, MTH 252 and MTH 252H.

Enrollment limited to students in a Honors Bachelor of Arts, Honors Bachelor of Fine Arts, Honors Bachelor of Music or Honors Bachelor of Science degrees.

Enrollment limited to students in the College of Engineering, College of Forestry or Pre-Engineering Program colleges.
